content: NDA / no-public-URL projects: accepted patterns are (1) keep full process write-up but anonymize client, data and exact figures, (2) screenshots with fictional seed data, (3) a disclaimer line at top stating why there is no live URL and that a walkthrough is available on request, (4) present live in interview, (5) password-gate the middle of the story. Get client permission where it exists. Sources are design/career blogs and forums, not legal advice.
